_about: Availability of products for which the run found no price. status: online = the price is shown to a person on the company's site/app but cannot be collected automatically (robots.txt forbids it, a bot wall, a booking/login flow or an in-app price); none = no public price found (quote/contract, B2B, no site). verified says whether the price was actually seen. Keys: a ser (whole company) or a product_id (wins over the company). Companies/products not listed: none, with the reason from the sheet 'تقييم Scraping'.
